title: Technical Program Manager
description:
SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. - we invite you to be part of the solution!


About the role

Platform work at SoSafe carries outsized leverage. One well-run migration touches a dozen services at once. One adopted shared library saves every team that builds on it from solving the same problem twice. One monitoring signal catches a problem before a customer ever sees it. The work often goes unnoticed when it's going well, but its absence is felt across half of Product Development within a week.

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to embed into one of our platform teams and bring order to that complexity. You'll partner closely with the Product Manager, Engineering Manager, and their Tech Leads to drive the when and how of the roadmap: sequencing the work, surfacing risk early, holding cross-team commitments together, and making sure what ships lands cleanly across every team that depends on it.

This role owns program outcomes, not status reports. You'll think in systems, work in mechanisms, and earn trust by removing friction the team didn't know was costing them time.

Here's how you'll make a difference

  • Own end-to-end delivery for programs that touch a dozen services at once: an architecture migration, a compliance remediation, a legacy system sunset.

  • Partner with Product Management and GTM stakeholders on platform changes with customer-facing impact, keeping rollouts, communications, and external commitments in lockstep with engineering delivery.

  • Drive adoption of shared platform capabilities that other teams are supposed to build on, closing the gap between "we shipped it" and teams actually using it.

  • Manage multi-team migrations where downstream consumers, external commitments, and legacy constraints all need to land in the right order. A missed dependency here costs months, not days.

  • Run the mechanics that keep a dozen concurrent programs honest: dependency maps, risk logs, decision records, and the recurring check-ins nobody wants to run but everybody needs.

  • Bring rigor to how delivery health gets measured, incident counts, adoption rates, time-to-land, and use it to drive change instead of producing another report.

What makes you a great fit

  • You've run complex, cross-functional technical programs and can point to ones where the technical decisions were yours to shape, not just to track.

  • You hold your own in deep engineering conversations. You don't need to write the code, but you need to understand what's being argued about and why it matters.

  • You bring structure to ambiguity without over-engineering it. Your default is the lightest mechanism that solves the problem.

  • You've worked where the consumers of your output are other engineering teams, whether that's infrastructure, data pipelines, or internal APIs.

  • You've managed a migration or sunset with real downstream impact, and you know how to land it without breaking trust.

  • You communicate directly. Short sentences, clear asks, no filler. You write decisions down and make sure the right people see them.

  • You're comfortable in Jira, Confluence, and the rest of a modern engineering toolchain, and you have opinions about how they should be used.

Nice to have

  • Background in infrastructure, data engineering, or applied AI/ML platforms.

  • Experience inside a SaaS company through a phase of platform consolidation or modernization.

  • Familiarity with SLOs or monitoring practice as a delivery signal, not just an SRE artifact.

What success looks like

  • 3 months. You're embedded with the team's engineering leadership, have a clear read on every active program, and have started reshaping how the group plans, tracks, and communicates delivery.

  • 6 months. You're the trusted operating partner for the group. Initiatives that were drifting are landing predictably, and the cross-team dependencies that used to surprise us are surfacing weeks earlier.

  • 12 months. The team is delivering with a rhythm other groups want to copy. The mechanisms you built are running themselves, and you're picking the next compounding problem to solve.

 

What we offer*

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, corporate discounts

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

description:
Who We Are:
At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes — all while raising money for the causes they love.

Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £100 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.

And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.

🔑 About The Job

Omaze is a subscription-first fundraising platform with over 1.2 million active subscribers. We run large-scale prize draws that change people's lives — and we need flawless payments infrastructure behind every one. This role is the operational heartbeat of that infrastructure: owning reconciliation, dunning, vendor relationships, and the day-to-day health of our payments ecosystem. Looking for someone immediately available.

🔧 What You’ll Be Doing

CORE PAYMENTS OPS

Daily Operations

  • Monitor payment success rates, failure trends, and processor health dashboards daily

  • Investigate and resolve payment exceptions, chargebacks, and disputes end-to-end

  • Own the subscriber payment lifecycle from authorisation through to settlement

  • Manage refund workflows and ensure timely, accurate processing

  • Maintain internal runbooks and escalation protocols for payment incidents

DUNNING & RECOVERY

Failed Payment Recovery

  • Own and continuously optimise the full dunning cycle — retry logic, timing, and messaging

  • Analyse decline reason codes and apply segmented retry strategies accordingly

  • Collaborate with CRM and Product to improve pre-dunning communications

  • Test and iterate dunning cadences using A/B frameworks where available

RECONCILIATION

Financial Accuracy

  • Run daily and monthly reconciliation across Stripe and Shopify Subscriptions at 1.2M-subscriber scale

  • Identify, investigate, and resolve discrepancies between processor reports and internal records

  • Build and maintain automated reconciliation tooling in partnership with Engineering or BI

VENDOR MANAGEMENT

Stripe & Shopify

  • Serve as the primary internal owner for both Stripe and Shopify Subscriptions relationships

  • Manage configuration, feature adoption, account health, and platform update impact assessments across Stripe and Shopify Subscriptions

  • Lead regular vendor reviews and negotiate on SLAs, fees, and product roadmap alignment

  • Evaluate alternative or complementary payment tools as the business scales

REPORTING & INSIGHT

Performance Intelligence

  • Produce weekly and monthly payments performance report for Finance and leadership, covering reconciliation sign-off, authorisation rates, payment-failure churn, recovery performance, and net revenue recovered

  • Maintain a payment ops dashboard that gives real-time visibility to key stakeholders

  • Surface actionable insight from decline and recovery data to inform product, CRM, and commercial decisions

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL

Collaboration & Compliance

  • Partner with Product to shape payment-related feature development and releases

  • Support compliance with PCI-DSS requirements and internal data handling policies

  • Brief Customer Support on payment issues affecting member experience

🤩 About You

  • Experience in a payments, fintech, or subscription operations role

  • Hands-on experience with Stripe, including billing, radar, and reporting APIs

  • Proven ownership of a dunning or failed-payment recovery programme

  • Experience running reconciliation at scale (>100k transactions/month)

  • Strong data skills — comfortable in Excel/Sheets

  • Ability to read and interpret processor reporting and settlement files

  • Excellent attention to detail and a low tolerance for unexplained discrepancies

  • Clear written communicator able to brief both technical and non-technical audiences

THE KIND OF PERSON WHO'LL THRIVE HERE

  • Relentlessly precise. At 1.2 million subscribers, small error rates become big numbers fast. You're the person who notices the discrepancy everyone else missed and doesn't rest until it's explained.

  • Recovery-minded. You don't just run the dunning process — you obsess over why cards fail, segment your retries intelligently, and find percentage points of recovery others leave behind.

  • A confident vendor partner. You build strong relationships with Stripe and Shopify account teams, know how to escalate effectively, and hold vendors accountable to SLAs without burning bridges.

  • Process-builder, not just process-follower. You inherit some workflows and build others from scratch. You're comfortable creating runbooks, automating repetitive checks, and leaving things better than you found them.

  • Clear under pressure. When a payment incident lands at pace, you triage fast, communicate clearly to Finance and leadership, and resolve it without drama.

🙌 What’s In It For You

  • Generous stock options scheme

  • 25 days annual leave PLUS Bank Holidays

  • Private medical and dental insurance

  • 9% employer pension contributions, when you contribute at least 2%

  • A generous personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships

  • Enhanced family leave policies

  • Life assurance of 4x your salary

DEI Statement

We actively seek out diversity of thought and experience to drive innovation. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and perspectives and work hard to ensure that every Omaze employee can bring their authentic self to work at all times.
